title: precheck names the trailers detector's first passing date from the wall clock, but its window follows main's tip time
goal: Found in the SP-vmxdxtru review: bl_land.windowed_detector names the newest flagged commit's date plus TRAILER_WINDOW_DAYS as the day the trailers check can first pass, but bl_intake.trailer_findings reads the commits within TRAILER_WINDOW_DAYS of main's tip (no clock), so the check passes only once main has moved that far past the commit; precheck's line says the earliest date and that the window follows main's tip, not the calendar.

run: import pathlib,sys;t=pathlib.Path('_tools/bl_land.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8');ok="main's tip" in t[t.index('def windowed_detector'):t.index('def cmd_precheck')];print('precheck names main tip in the trailers window:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

repro_reason: the wrong date shows only against a real main whose tip lags the clock; the repro reads whether the warning names main's tip
notes: Premise: its repro, tightened at planning to look for "main's tip" in windowed_detector. Run on 2026-10-10: exit 1, False. Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 10 of 13).
